check_protobuf_implementation_type: check which protobuf implementation is active by calling Type() to return 'python' or 'cpp'
get_protobuf_implementation_version: get the protobuf implementation version by calling Version() to return the active version number
check_deterministic_serialization: check if default proto serialization is deterministic by calling IsPythonDefaultSerializationDeterministic()
set_protobuf_implementation_type: set the protobuf implementation type to 'python' or 'cpp' by calling _SetType() for benchmarking
review_api_implementation_module: review the protobuf api_implementation module to understand implementation selection logic and environment variable overrides
